title: The daemon probes deployed environments on a durable schedule and raises one incident
description:
SPIDR child 1 of task-7683a432eb3f4e87b1eb0cbc6e3a55ff (architect-20a6d1eb, 2026-09-05). Dependency-free LEAF.

WHAT THIS ROW OWNS: the probe loop. For every environment with a deploy receipt, probe the health URL on a DURABLE schedule (default 60 s, per-environment setting), record `moe-health-probe/1` {environment, sha, status, latencyMs, at} in a BOUNDED ring (last 1440), derive UP / DEGRADED / DOWN, and raise exactly ONE Needs-you incident after three consecutive failures. No backups, no rollback, no UI.

MEASURED AT HEAD (branch moe/work-2026-09-04) by architect-20a6d1eb: `/health/read` reports the DAEMON's own health only (apps/daemon/src/http/health-read.ts, where KNOWN_PROVIDERS lives at :34); there is no probe of a deployed product anywhere. The gap is real.

THREE PROPERTIES THAT ARE EASY TO GET WRONG AND HARD TO NOTICE:
1. EXACTLY ONE INCIDENT. Three consecutive failures raise one card; continued failure must NOT raise a second, and recovery must CLOSE it. A loop that raises per-probe floods Needs-you at one card a minute and makes the queue useless precisely when the operator needs it.
2. THE RING IS BOUNDED at 1440. An unbounded probe log grows without limit in a durable store and is the kind of thing nobody notices until the store is huge.
3. SURVIVES A RESTART from durable records: no probe lost, and - the harder half - NO DOUBLE SCHEDULE. A restart that re-registers an already-scheduled probe doubles the rate silently, and the symptom is a store filling twice as fast rather than an error.

COORDINATION, not a dependency: the deploy receipt this reads belongs to task-04b3ce7e349743c2a156d32ee5550ba5 under a SIBLING parent (containerized deployment), which the parent rail forbids depending on. If it has not landed, build against the receipt shape recorded there and say so in the record - do not invent a different one, because child 2's rollback resolves through the same receipts.
definitionOfDone: A probe loop test with a FAKE target drives UP -> DOWN: three consecutive failures raise EXACTLY ONE incident card, continued failure raises NO second card, and recovery CLOSES it. Assert the card count across many failing probes - a per-probe raise floods the queue at one card a minute exactly when the operator needs it usable.

The ring is BOUNDED at 1440: after more than 1440 probes the oldest are gone and the newest are present, asserted by count and by content. An unbounded durable probe log is invisible until the store is large.

PROBES SURVIVE A DAEMON RESTART from durable records: no probe is lost, and NO DOUBLE SCHEDULE - assert the probe RATE after a restart equals the rate before. A silently doubled schedule shows up as a store filling twice as fast, never as an error.

`moe-health-probe/1` records {environment, sha, status, latencyMs, at} and the derived UP / DEGRADED / DOWN state is a function of the ring, not a stored flag - assert the state changes when the ring does, so the two cannot disagree.

GOVERNOR AMENDMENT 20:10Z: the shipped probe schedule is certified as it IS - composition registers ONE monitoring/health-probes job at the default 60 s (composition:579) and the ring probes every environment per tick; assert one registration at boot and that a second boot does not double it. Per-environment intervals are NOT a production setting today and are NOT certified here: they are follow-on task-078232fb9b9d4c06a5faf3c02adaf705 (child task-cc05c473 stays DONE, not reopened). PROBE_URL_MISSING refuses with code + layer for an environment with a deploy receipt but no health URL - an environment that cannot be probed says so rather than reporting UP.
Gates quoted with their `Test Files N passed` count lines: `pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test`, `pnpm typecheck`.
taskRails: EXACTLY ONE INCIDENT PER OUTAGE. A per-probe raise makes Needs-you unusable at the moment it matters most.
THE RING IS BOUNDED. A durable log with no ceiling is a slow leak nobody sees.
NO DOUBLE SCHEDULE ON RESTART. Assert the rate, not just that probing resumed.
AN UNPROBEABLE ENVIRONMENT IS NEVER 'UP'. Absence of a health URL is a refusal, not a green state.
NO BACKUPS, NO ROLLBACK, NO UI: those are children 2 and 3. The deploy receipt comes from a SIBLING parent's row (task-04b3ce7e) - build against its recorded shape, do not invent a second one.
